snippet.title: Muddy Hands? Let's Get Clean! 🧼 Cleanliness Is Half of Faith | Islam for Kids #shorts
snippet.description:
Oh no! Muddy hands after playing outside! What do we do?

Our Prophet Muhammad-e-Mustafa (Sallallahu Ta'ala Alaihi Wa Aalihi Wasallam) said: "Cleanliness is half of faith."

So let's get clean: wash your hands with soap, brush your teeth up and down, comb your hair and put on clean clothes. Allah loves those who keep clean, and everyone loves a fresh, clean hug!

Source
• Sahih Muslim 223: https://sunnah.com/muslim:223

Masjid-e-Nabawi footage: DesignwithRiyas on Pixabay (https://pixabay.com/videos/id-112361/)

We never show any Prophet or Companion. Only an ordinary family is drawn.
For ages 3 to 9 · Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jama'at
